Myanmar shaper: Ra-As-H reph handling and pre-base matra reordering.

Ports harfrust ot/shaper/myanmar.rs (HarfBuzz main). Syllables are found first, locl/ccmp apply, then initial reordering assigns Myanmar positions, the four basic features apply in order, and the four other features apply after clearing syllables.

Imports

../buffer, ../feature, ../font, ../tag, gsub, indic_table, map, maskbits, myanmar_machine, syllabic

Basic features applied in order after reordering. 
MyanmarOtherTags: array[4, string] = ["pres", "abvs", "blws", "psts"]
Other features applied after clearing syllables.
